atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D mobile game touch-control sprite atlas for the original fantasy action game Arcane Duel.
Primary request: one square 1536 by 1536 PNG atlas, genuinely transparent RGBA background. Exactly twelve separate controls, arranged in a perfectly aligned FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW grid. No drawn grid, no labels. Each control centered in its own generous cell, isolated by fully transparent gutters at least 24 pixels, no overlapping decorations.
Style: refined hand-painted dark fantasy UI, sculpted antique gold and worn black iron, deep desaturated teal enamel, restrained filigree and small moon/star incisions, coherent with a medieval moonlit castle game. Rich metal relief and crisp silhouette, not flat vector, not photoreal product buttons. Readable at 55 to 95 pixels on a phone; bold broad silhouette, avoid tiny busy details. Low-key warm rim light, no large bloom or fog outside sprites.
The exact reading order is left to right, top to bottom:
ROW ONE: (1) large circular hollow joystick outer ring, no disk in the middle, four subtle compass tips; (2) separate round thumb cap with solid dark teal iron face and embossed tiny antique-gold diamond; (3) large circular hollow basic-attack frame, decisive small blade-like ornament at its upper right, completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT center for an existing hero attack image; (4) smaller circular hollow skill frame with four restrained gold prongs, completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT center for an existing skill image.
ROW TWO: (5) jump button, circular dark teal face with one unmistakable gold upward arrow and subtle second chevron; (6) dodge/dash button, circular dark teal face with three forward gold streaks and a clear arrowhead; (7) interact button, circular dark teal face with a simple clear gold open palm reaching toward a small diamond; (8) cancel button, circular black iron face and clear muted gold X.
ROW THREE: (9) pressed version of the exact row-one attack frame, same silhouette/center with slightly brighter amber inner rim; (10) pressed version of the exact row-one skill frame, same silhouette/center with slightly brighter amber inner rim; (11) pressed version of row-two jump, same clear upward glyph and outline but brighter warm metal; (12) pressed version of row-two dash, same clear streak/arrow glyph and outline but brighter warm metal.
All control circles are front facing, orthographic, no perspective tilt. Attack frame slightly larger than skill frame. Same physical size for normal and pressed pairs. Keep each control visually centered in its cell, no contact between cells. Keep entire decorations safely within its cell.
Transparency is essential: every pixel outside each control silhouette is transparent, and the joystickOuter, attackFrame, skillFrame, pressedAttack and pressedSkill central holes are truly fully transparent. No background/color plate behind the sheet, no black/checkerboard baked background, no drop shadow square.
Constraints: no text at all, no numbers, no letters, no character skill illustrations, no branded symbols, no watermark, no screenshot, no phone, no full UI layout. Only the twelve finished separate controls.
appIcon:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished Android launcher app icon for the original dark fantasy action game Arcane Duel.
Primary request: a square 1024 by 1024 hand-painted fantasy game emblem, full-bleed opaque background, NO TEXT. An ancient antique-gold arched magical portal is the unmistakable central silhouette. Inside the portal a blazing orange flame crescent and a cold luminous blue moon core spiral toward each other like two dueling elements. Behind the portal two elegant crossed ancient weapons, a sword and an arcane staff, read as one clean powerful X shape. The portal is carved with restrained celestial and leaf-like filigree, weathered gold metal and dark teal enamel.
Composition: strong single central emblem with clear chunky silhouette for very small launcher size. The entire meaningful portal, inner moon-fire core and recognizable weapon handles MUST fit inside the central 66 percent square of the canvas, centered; leave the outer 17 percent on every edge as dark atmospheric padding for Android adaptive-circle/squircle cropping. No frame or rounded-square border. Background fills every pixel to the edges: very dark desaturated midnight blue stone/castle mist with minimal details, warm amber on left and icy moon blue on right, no busy background buildings.
Style: premium original 2D dark fantasy game cover painting, deep indigo/black/teal and aged gold, engraved sculptural metal, brushwork, intense but tasteful small core lighting. Matches ornate antique-gold UI and a moonlit gothic ruin fantasy battle game. Central flame and moon remain clear, not a white glowing blob. Strong medium contrast focal emblem, subdued corners.
Constraints: completely opaque image, square 1024 by 1024, no transparency. No writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademark symbols, watermark, smartphone, screenshot, UI buttons, characters or cute cartoon mascot. This is one finished app icon, not an icon sheet, not a mockup.
